reviews.review_description:
I bought this game with not a lot of high hopes, and I was right. The premise of the game is fun but it’s just not. There are only three settings, the game is super loud, you fall through the map, your gun doesn’t shoot straight and a lot more.
I still have hope for this game… just not a lot

All these 5 star reviews are glaze because RIGHT NOW this game is not good. me and my friend have been playing this game for an hour and we think its really buggy, whenever i attack there is random invisible walls that you cant get past and the bots have way to much health because i have to shoot 8 bullets out of my machine gun to kill someone and the "machine gun" isn't even full auto.

reviews.review_title: Pretty Good but is still progressing
reviews.review_description: I find even tho it’s in its first day of release, the game is playable and works decently well, nothing will be perfect but it will only get better from here😬👌 the game has a few bugs or glitchy areas, but the owner is working to address each issue to improve the game. I believe this will be a good game for 1vs1’s or 2vs2’s. A 4 player lobby is very fun compared to the 2 player lobbies. The graphics are also pretty good too. I say for the price, it’s worth playing even in its early form

Already a great game with a couple bugs but what can I expect from early access but the game has all functional features and is a fun game to play definitely a five stars and definitely gonna take off

This game is very raw so far but it's a one of a kind concept. The price is exactly right for where the game is at right now. I encourage people to play it, I know it's gonna get better. Some of the controls are a little janky at the moment but all in all I would recommend buying and playing. This is the kind of concept you want for VR.

if this didn’t take like 7 years to make and was 3$ instead of 10$ it would be a bit more understandable how trash this is. the game is full of bugs (theres like 3 ways to fall out of the map) there is no mass select so maneuvering troops is way to costly. there is no tutorial. if you loose the first battle your essentially screwed, as seemingly the only ￼way to get more money is to kill troops, and getting new standard troops is impossible. once you purchase troops it takes a minute before you can use them. piloting planes is way to difficult as you only get one shot
and its almost impossible to see your surroundings.
